long_description.body:
Take your Epiphone instrument with you in one of our soft cases. They are made with a canvas exterior and 5 mm padded interiors and come equipped with two adjustable straps and a handy external zippered accessory compartment that's perfect for straps, picks, cables, and other essentials.





Rugged black canvas exterior




Black padded polyester lining




Internal dimensions: 37.1” length, 11” upper body width, 14.5" lower body width, 2.7” depth
